items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1976-02-04
items.q: And, Lala, if you caught him... most trumpet players, they couldn't take it.

ctx.x: So, he scowled at me, he said, so your sons of bitches take, you son of, some son of bitches, he said, take too many liberties with people. He was mad because lawyer had played, see? I don't think it was so much about the horn. And, I used to know his name, I can't think of his name. He was one of those supposed to be hot trumpet players, right? She called him. And, and, that was the thing with lawyer everywhere, I mean, where he went. Guys who were celebrated in their hometown as being great trumpet players…
Do you think, do you think that it bothered most of them that he was that good or do you think they really felt a legitimate warmth and passion for the way he played?
